title: PRECEPT: Security Self-Improvement of Coding Agents via Evolving Principles
title_zh: PRECEPT：通过持续演化的原则实现编码智能体的安全自我改进
abstract_en: AI coding agents increasingly write and submit code with limited human review, and much of it passes functional tests while remaining insecure. We show that these failures persist. Across 14 task sequences, Codex, Claude Code, and Qwen Code fixed a vulnerability 85.7% of the time when shown the failing security test, then reintroduced the same vulnerability class in a new session 26.7% of the time, about as often as agents that had never seen it (27.5%). The capability is present; the retention is not. Neither recording the repair in the agent's persistent context nor supplying published secure coding principles closed the gap: the recorded fix stayed tied to the family of the task it came from, and the principles, written for human developers, remained too general to apply to the code at hand. The knowledge exists; it is not activated. We call the missing ability security self-improvement: an agent learns from its own security failures so that each lesson persists across sessions, applies to new code, and does not break what works. We present PRECEPT, which equips coding agents with this ability through an evolving library that starts from authoritative secure coding principles and revises them against the agent's own failures, so that each principle comes to fire on the code where that agent actually goes wrong. A revision is kept only if fresh executions show it makes code more secure while keeping functional success within a small tolerance of the agent without the library. Improvement continues across evolution steps rather than saturating after the first. On task families never seen during evolution, PRECEPT's weakest agent reaches 97.1% secure working code, above the strongest unaided agent at 81.9% and the strongest baseline at 87.7%.
abstract_zh: 编码智能体生成的代码即使通过功能测试，也可能存在安全漏洞。在 14 个任务序列中，Codex、Claude Code 和 Qwen Code 在看到未通过的安全测试后，有 85.7% 的时候能修复漏洞；但在新会话中，它们有 26.7% 的时候再次引入同类漏洞，与从未见过该漏洞的智能体（27.5%）相近。将修复记录写入持久上下文，经验仍局限于原任务族；直接提供已发布的安全编码原则，又因表述过于宽泛而难以应用到具体代码。为此，PRECEPT 以权威安全编码原则为起点，依据智能体自身的安全失败迭代修订原则库，使原则能在智能体容易出错的代码情境中发挥作用。只有当新一轮运行表明修订能提高代码安全性，且功能成功率相对不使用原则库时的降幅不超过预设容差，修订才会被保留。安全表现随多轮迭代持续改善。在演化阶段未见过的任务族上，采用 PRECEPT 后表现最弱的智能体也有 97.1% 的代码同时满足安全和功能要求，高于无辅助时表现最强的智能体（81.9%）和最强基线（87.7%）。
key_points_zh: 会修复不等于能记住：看到失败的安全测试后，修复率为 85.7%，但新会话中的同类漏洞复发率仍接近未见过该漏洞的对照组。
持久化修复记录难以跨任务族迁移，而面向人类开发者的通用安全原则又难以落实到具体代码。
PRECEPT 根据智能体自身的失败迭代修订原则，并用新一轮运行验证安全收益和功能表现，再决定是否保留修订。
在演化阶段未见过的任务族上，采用 PRECEPT 后表现最弱的智能体也达到 97.1% 的安全与功能双达标率，超过最强无辅助智能体的 81.9% 和最强基线的 87.7%。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是根据编码代理自身的安全失败修订可跨会话复用的原则库，并通过新一轮执行筛选修订：只有安全性提高且功能成功率的下降不超出容差时才保留。未见任务族上的量化对比支持这一设计，但摘录未给出具体容差或消融结果，也未表明修订或验证机制本身得到改进。
